channel.title: The Bridge India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Bridge India (thebridge.in)

item.title: Telangana outlines Olympic Mission 2036 and major sports investment push at Sports Tech Podium 2025
item.description: Jayesh Ranjan says the State aims to field athletes in every Olympic sport India competes in when the nation hosts the 2036 Games.

item.title: Mumbai Smashers complete fairytale surge to claim Indian Pickleball League title
item.description: Mumbai defeated Hyderabad Royals 5–1 in the final to lift the IPBL crown after entering the playoffs from sixth place.

item.title: Men’s Hockey Junior World Cup 2025: India falls to Germany, third straight last-four exit against European giants
item.description: Anmol Ekka scored India’s lone goal as Germany produced a dominant semifinal display in Chennai.

item.title: FC Goa edge East Bengal on penalties to retain AIFF Super Cup title
item.description: Goa won 6–5 in a tense shootout after a goalless 120 minutes, becoming the first team to defend the Super Cup crown.

item.title: CK444 Platform Overview: Features, Games & User Experience
item.description: This review covers the essentials: games, bonuses, payments, mobile experience, and security.

item.title: ISSF World Cup Final: Zoravar Sandhu finishes 7th in men's trap; India ends with 6 medals
item.description: India finished the medal table in second position just behind China, with 2G, 3S, 1B.

item.title: SAFF Women's Club C'ship: East Bengal Women beat Transport United in opener
item.description: The IWL Champions put four goals past the defence of Bhutanese champions to start their campaign on high.

item.title: ISRL: Salman Khan Kicks off Round 2; Team Gujarat Trailblazers Leads the Points Table
item.description: The stadium recorded a massive surge in attendance with over 18,000 fans packing the venue, creating an unforgettable racing experience.

item.title: Praggnanandhaa wins FIDE Circuit 2025, qualifies for 2026 Candidates Tournament
item.description: The Chennai Grandmaster sealed his Candidates berth after finishing the season atop the FIDE Circuit standings.

item.title: WTT Finals 2025: Manush-Diya drawn with two tough Chinese pairs in Group A
item.description: The mixed doubles pair of Manush Shah and Diya Chitale will be the only Indians at the event
